info.name: SAP S/4HANA Sales Order Sales Orders API
info.description:
The SAP S/4HANA Sales Order API (API_SALES_ORDER_SRV) enables you to create, read, update, and delete sales orders in SAP S/4HANA.

Contact Support:
 Name: SAP API Support

item.name: Sap S/4hana Create a New Sales Order

request.description: Creates a new sales order in SAP S/4HANA. Supports deep insert, allowing you to create a header along with items, partners, pricing elements, schedule lines, billing plans, and text records in a single request. The SalesOrderType, SalesOrganization, DistributionChannel, and OrganizationDivision are required for creation.

item.name: Sap S/4hana Update a Sales Order Header

header.description: (Required) ETag value for optimistic concurrency control

request.description: Performs a partial update (MERGE/PATCH) on an existing sales order header. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated. Requires an If-Match header with the entity ETag for optimistic concurrency control.
